title: Паника у машины и звонок из полиции  (Panic by the Car and a Call from the Police)

segments.t: Out in the courtyard, Nagiyev panics when the bound man in the car recognizes him as a celebrity and orders Senya and Fedya to hide him inside. Meanwhile at the police patrol car, Chef Barinov demands his phone call and asks the officers to ring Dmitry Nagiyev.
Я имею право на телефонный звонок.
И он подтвердил, что я, это я.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
'He can hear everything!' The grammar packs 'he' and 'all' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Tamara Petrovna!' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'Tamara' and 'Petrovna' in a few short words.
'He recognized me!' An emphatic spoken line centered on the verb meaning 'recognised'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Good Lord, he recognized me.' In Russian, the idea of 'good Lord!' flows naturally into 'recognised' without extra filler words.
'We cannot leave him here.' Dmitry anchors the line on 'him', while 'to leave' completes the thought.
'Grab him, Tamara Petrovna.' In Russian, the idea of 'take' flows naturally into 'Petrovna' without extra filler words. Dmitry answers right away.
Я имею право на телефонный звонок.
'I have the right to a phone call.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'call'.
'Call Dmitry Nagiyev.' The grammar packs 'will call' and 'Nagiyev' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'He is the owner of my restaurant.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'he' and finishing on 'restaurant'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
И он подтвердил, что я, это я.
'And he will confirm that I am who I say I am.' The grammar packs 'both' and 'this' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Go ahead and dictate the number, I guess.' The meaning hinges on 'read out' working together with 'probably' in spoken Russian.
'Are you serious?' Notice how Russian expresses 'yes' and 'really?!' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Dmitry answers right away.
'Well, alright then.' Dmitry anchors the line on 'come on', while 'really?!' completes the thought. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Я имею право на телефонный звонок.
И он подтвердил, что я, это я.

That wraps up this scene as nagiyev panics when the bound photographer recognizes him outside the restaurant, while detained Chef Barinov convinces the police to call Nagiyev to vouch for him. See you next time!
